name: microsip-call-log-sync
description: Sistema de sincronizacion de llamadas MicroSIP

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd .. && cd agent && npm install && cd .. && cd dashboard && npm install && cd ..
scripts.build-all: cd server && npm run build && cd .. && cd agent && npm run build && cd .. && cd dashboard && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.build-agent-exe: cd agent && npm install && npm run build:exe && cd ..
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,AGENT,DASHBOARD -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start-server" "npm run start-agent" "npm run dev-dashboard"
